docs(security): apply main ruleset and correct SEC-001 bypass analysis

Apply repository ruleset main-branch-protection (id 26129824) to main:
PR-required, no force-push, no branch deletion, 14 required status checks.
Correct SEC-001: --no-verify cannot be detected inside a hook; the
authoritative control is the server-side ruleset. Record evidence under
evidence/ and defer SEC-007 (signing) as an explicit owner decision.

head_commit.message:
fix(docs): replace Slack credential placeholders with .env guidance

Slack token placeholders in docs/user-guide/configuration.md were flagged
by the secret scan (P0). Replace bare placeholders with guidance to keep
secrets in .env / Docker secrets.

Also ignore local TLS material (certs/, *.pem, *.key) so test fixtures
never land in VCS.
